title: Going RV
description:

Pat and Stephanie need a larger RV to live in full-time and travel all year long to visit local distilleries and brew their own beer.

description:

Eric and Tamara need the perfect toy hauler to live and work in while on the road.

title: Going RV
description:

Pat and Stephanie need a larger RV to travel and live in full-time while working and brewing on the road.

title: Going RV
description:

JP and Autumn look to upgrade their RV to a Fifth-Wheel with enough space and amenities for the family.

title: Going RV
description:
S03 E06 — Engaged Naval Officers Need First Home On Wheels
Engaged naval officers look for their first home together that they can travel with.

title: Going RV
description:
S03 E07 — Fifth Wheel for Family of Four
Mike and Erica are looking to upgrade to a fifth wheel with more space and amenities.

title: Going RV
description:
S03 E08 — Former Football Pro Seeks Fourth RV
Keith and Tia Sims look for their fourth mobile home with more space and amenities to make them feel at home.

title: Going RV
description:

Scott and Shanna love to vacation and want to upgrade their gas model for a more fuel-efficient diesel engine.

title: Going RV
description:

Darnell and Sheila love to travel, but want to ditch flying, so they look for an RV to add comfort and ease to their travels within the continental U.S.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E03 — Hitting The Road Full-Time
Katy, Stephen and their two children take to the road to spend more quality time with nature and each other.

title: Going RV
description:

Ravyn and Jesse search for a unit that will fit their needs, which means an extra bedroom for their daughter and ample storage space due to living in the travel trailer full-time.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E04 — Andy and Opie -- Bachelors
When Aunt Bee goes away for a visit, Andy and Opie discover the problems of bachelorhood.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E05 — The Cow Thief
The Mayberry mayor demands Andy get a crime expert from the city to help solve several cow thefts.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E06 — Barney Mends a Broken Heart
Peggy McMillan breaks a date with Andy and Barney tries to console him.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E07 — Lawman Barney
Barney loses his self-confidence when two farmers ignore his warning to stop selling produce from their truck.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E08 — The Mayberry Band
The Mayberry band, which has more flats than sharps, gets ready for its annual trip to the state band competition.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E09 — Floyd, the Gay Deceiver
Floyd tries to impress his pen pal Madelyn Grayson, a rich widow, by pretending to be a wealthy man. Things get complicated when Madelyn decides to visit Mayberry and meet him face-to-face.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E10 — Opie's Rival
Opie is jealous of all the time his father spends with his new girlfriend, so he feigns several illnesses to keep them apart.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E11 — Convicts at Large
Barney and Floyd run out of gas on their way home from a fishing trip. While looking for a telephone, they are captured and held hostage in a remote cabin by a group of escaped female convicts.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E12 — The Bed Jacket
Aunt Bee drops hints that she wants a bed jacket for her birthday, but Andy is oblivious. When he realizes he let his aunt down, Andy goes to great lengths to get her the bed jacket.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E13 — The Bank Job
Barney sets out to prove that the Mayberry Bank is prone to robberies and is not safe. Disguised as a cleaning lady, he easily slips by the bank teller and accidentally locks himself in the vault.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E14 — One Punch Opie
Opie must learn to fight when new boy Steve moves into town, bullies him, and causes trouble for him and his friends.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E15 — Barney and the Governor
Barney issues the governor a parking ticket when his chauffeur parks in a no-parking zone. The governor, impressed, visits Mayberry to commend him for doing his job without favoritism.

title: A Snapshot of Forever
description: Wedding photographer Jessie Brookes' happy life in her small town is changed when a famous Hollywood actor attends her sister's wedding.

title: Cider and Sunsets
description: Marley is great at organizing other people's engagements but unlucky with love. However, the man who could jeopardize her latest project may also be Mr. Right.

title: For the Love of Chocolate
description: Preparing for the annual Masters of Chocolate Festival, Aria's plans get rattled when she loses her partner shortly before the competition. However, a dashing single father soon steps in to help Aria find the winning ingredient.

title: Love at the Ranch
description: Sparks fly between a big-city reporter and a ranch owner as she researches the life of a romance novelist.

Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.

title: The Andy Griffith Show

Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E19 — Class Reunion
Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E20 — Rafe Hollister Sings
Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E21 — Opie and the Spoiled Kid
Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E22 — The Great Filling Station Robbery
Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:

Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:

Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E25 — The Darlings Are Coming
Andy unexpectedly has his hands full as The Darlings, a family of musicians from the mountains, arrive in Mayberry to meet a bus due the next day.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E26 — Andy's English Valet
Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S03 E27 — Barney's First Car
Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.

description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

A pack of hunting dogs overruns the Mayberry courthouse just as Andy is trying to impress a state official.

title: The Andy Griffith Show

The Darling family returns to Mayberry and asks Andy for help in dealing with Ernest T. Bass, a mountain man who keeps pursuing Briscoe's married daughter Charlene.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:

Barney and Gomer are responsible for watching over two thieves who are temporarily jailed in Mayberry. Between the two of them, the criminals manage to escape three times.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E01 — Opie the Birdman
Opie takes on the job of raising three baby birds after he accidentally kills the mother bird and learns important life lessons along the way.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E02 — The Haunted House
Andy, Barney, and Gomer look for a lost baseball while exploring a supposedly haunted house and experience some strange events inside.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E03 — Ernest T. Bass Joins the Army
Mountain man Ernest T. Bass goes on a window-breaking ruckus around town after the army refuses to accept him in their ranks. When Andy and Barney arrest him, he explains to them that he wants a uniform to attract women.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E04 — The Sermon for Today
A preacher urges the residents of Mayberry to relax and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E05 — Briscoe Declares for Aunt Bee
Briscoe Darling decides to court and marry Aunt Bee after he is treated to her hospitality and home cooking. When he resorts to kidnapping, Andy rescues Aunt Bee and convinces her to make Briscoe work hard to clean up their home.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E06 — Gomer the House Guest
Gomer moves in with Andy after he loses his job at the filling station. Before long, the Taylor house turns into another filling station as Gomer's customers line up to get their cars looked at in Andy's driveway.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E07 — A Black Day for Mayberry
Barney lets it slip that a top-secret shipment of gold will make its way through Mayberry on the way to Fort Knox. Everyone in town soon knows about the gold and welcomes it with a carnival-like reception.
